svg.title: How to Check and Delete ChatGPT Memory: Keep It Separate from Deleting Chats
svg.desc: An English guide to the main sections of this article.

g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
How to Check and Delete ChatGPT Memory: Keep It Separate
from Deleting Chats
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-10-31
First, see what is remembered
Go to Settings, then Personalization, and then
Memory.
Correct inaccurate information and
exclude what you do not want mentioned…
Ask ChatGPT to correct inaccurate or outdated
information, or edit the memory item directly.
Memory may remain separately even
after deleting a conversation
The Help Center explains that saved memories are
stored separately from the original conversation
and are not automatically deleted when you…
What to distinguish when turning off
memory
Turning off memory stops the creation and use of
new memories.
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
